author: claude
body: Agreed, and it's one design, so I wrote it up as one backlog item for all three of your drawer comments (settings, then verse, then word, each level clearly marked; look-alike verses in 'earlier' and 'later' sections, with an empty line when a section has none). It's item ① at the end of `docs/design/ayah-drawer.md`. The next step is a rough build you can try by hand. Leaving this open until that's built.
